title: Detect config (detect_*)
description: Specifies an AI model, confidence levels and the prompts to detect. Every section is required but may be empty ({} or []). Fields not defined here are treated as comments by the server.

name.x-errorMessage: is not a valid detect config name: it must start with detect_

model.description: Model file the server should load, e.g. person_weapons_32_mlnlca.trt.

conf.description: Default confidence threshold. Applies to any prompt without its own threshold. Server default if omitted.

iou.description: Intersection-over-union threshold for box suppression. Server default if omitted.

warnings.description: Prompts that should raise warnings. Same structure as anomalies.

regularities.description: Prompts for normal activity. The only section that supports keyframes.

keyframes.description: Prompts that mark keyframes. Every keyframe must also be listed in regularities.prompts.

rename.description: Map of prompt -> label to report it as, e.g. {"a person": "after hours"}.

prompts.description: Natural-language prompts, e.g. "a person holding a handgun".

thresholds.description: Per-prompt confidence thresholds. Prompts without one use classifier.config.conf.

conditional.description: Condition expression, e.g. "history_avg(a person, 5s) >= 3". Parsed by the server, not by this schema.

action.description: Action expression, e.g. "create(anomaly:crowd:bound)". Parsed by the server, not by this schema.

region.description: Normalized frame region [x1, y1, x2, y2], each 0-1. Omit for the whole frame.
